properties.name: easyai.memory.enabled
properties.description: Whether the memory system (MemoryStore, memory tools, MemoryFlushAgent) is enabled.

properties.name: easyai.memory.global-dir
properties.description: Root directory for global memories. Supports ~ for home directory.

properties.name: easyai.memory.project-dir
properties.description: Root directory for project-scoped memories (relative to workDir).

properties.name: easyai.skills.enabled
properties.description: Whether the skill system is enabled.

properties.name: easyai.skills.paths
properties.description: Explicit skill file paths to load.

properties.name: easyai.skills.home-skill-dirs
properties.description: Directories under workDir to scan for skills.

properties.name: easyai.skills.inject-into-system-prompt
properties.description: Whether to inject skill descriptions into the system prompt.

properties.name: easyai.skills.system-prompt-format
properties.description: Format for skill descriptions in system prompt (CONCISE or FULL).

properties.name: easyai.system.otel.resource.attributes
properties.description: OpenTelemetry resource attributes (e.g., service.name, service.version). These will be registered as System Properties for OTEL SDK.

properties.name: easyai.system.otel.exporter.otlp.protocol
properties.description: OpenTelemetry OTLP exporter protocol (http/protobuf or grpc). Registered as System Property: otel.exporter.otlp.protocol.

properties.name: easyai.system.otel.exporter.otlp.endpoint
properties.description: OpenTelemetry OTLP exporter endpoint URL. Registered as System Property: otel.exporter.otlp.endpoint.

properties.name: easyai.system.otel.exporter.otlp.traces.endpoint
properties.description: OpenTelemetry OTLP traces endpoint URL. Registered as System Property: otel.exporter.otlp.traces.endpoint.

properties.name: easyai.system.otel.exporter.otlp.metrics.endpoint
properties.description: OpenTelemetry OTLP metrics endpoint URL. Registered as System Property: otel.exporter.otlp.metrics.endpoint.

properties.name: easyai.system.otel.exporter.otlp.headers
properties.description: OpenTelemetry OTLP exporter headers (comma-separated key=value pairs). Registered as System Property: otel.exporter.otlp.headers.

properties.name: easyai.system.logging.level
properties.description: Application logging level (TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR). Registered as System Property: logging.level.

properties.name: easyai.system.logging.format
properties.description: Logging output format (text or json). Registered as System Property: logging.format.

properties.name: easyai.system.logging.file.path
properties.description: Log file path. Registered as System Property: logging.file.path.

properties.name: easyai.system.app.name
properties.description: Application name. Registered as System Property: app.name.

properties.name: easyai.system.app.version
properties.description: Application version. Registered as System Property: app.version.

properties.name: easyai.system.db.pool.size
properties.description: Database connection pool size. Registered as System Property: db.pool.size.

properties.name: easyai.system.db.pool.max-lifetime
properties.description: Database connection pool max lifetime in milliseconds. Registered as System Property: db.pool.max-lifetime.

properties.name: easyai.system.db.connection.timeout
properties.description: Database connection timeout in milliseconds. Registered as System Property: db.connection.timeout.

properties.name: easyai.system.EXA_API_KEY
properties.description: Exa search API key. Enables the Exa web search provider for WebSearchTool. Obtain from https://exa.ai.

properties.name: easyai.system.PARALLEL_API_KEY
properties.description: Parallel search API key. Enables the Parallel web search provider for WebSearchTool. Obtain from https://parallel.ai.

properties.name: easyai.system.EASYAI_WEBSEARCH_PROVIDER
properties.description: Default web search provider for WebSearchTool. Selects which provider to use when multiple are available.
